verification_scope: Local raw files only; no live Databricks query, notebook run or source modification. Four modeled diseases and four proposed PAGASA stations only.

method.doh_validation: Onset first ten characters parsed ISO date; case count finite and nonnegative. Gold subset uses non-discarded selected classification groups, target provinces and years 2018-2025. Absent month is no observation, never inferred zero.
method.pagasa_validation: Matches Silver ranges: temperature -30..65 C, humidity 0..100%, wind nonnegative, direction 0..360. -999 null, -1 trace rainfall lower bound zero. Wind m/s converted to kph. Old TMEAN used when present; otherwise TMAX/TMIN midpoint. Complete rainfall month requires all expected daily dates and valid rainfall every day.

mapping.approval_state: All seven pending/needs_review. No external joins forecast-approved in inspected source code.
mapping.disease_product_mapping: Must be separately approved against canonical product identity and clinical/business evidence. DOH and weather fields cannot recover missing SKUs.
mapping.time_overlap: Official DOH/PAGASA/sales annual overlap is 2018-2024; actual eligible coverage varies by territory/disease/month. DOH 2026 partial; no PAGASA 2025 supplied. Retrospective onset dates without release timestamps do not prove real-time feature availability.
